readme: One true source (Brett, Nov 21 2026): a console setting is stored under exactly one key. This registry lists every setting that once had a second copy: the one key it is stored under now, the one wording every screen uses, and the old keys, which stay readable (read aliases, so a store that still carries one keeps working) but are never written again. `node framework/cli/check-settings-sources.mjs` (CI) fails when an alias is stored or registered again, when a retired wording comes back in a screen, or when two registered settings share a label. A new setting that would repeat one of these jobs is added here as an alias of it, never as its own key. The audit behind it: `node framework/cli/settings-audit.mjs`. A plugin ships its own part as `settings-sources.json` in its folder (same shape; the check reads both), and names a file of a plugin as `plugin:<folder>/<file>`.

sources.label: Builds at once
sources.meaning: How many headless builds (Claude sessions, swarm jobs) run at once on the VPS. The VPS enforces it; the queue books against the same number.
sources.owner: Brett only (his signed-in console, or the CLI at a terminal)
edit: Settings → Plugins → Agent cap → Builds at once
Builds → VPS Configuration → Build cap → Builds at once (the same key; console-control setting:vps.buildCap.maxBuilds reads it, the owner-only save is never a command)
Agent cap plugin API: PUT hard-limit {maxBuilds} (Brett's signed-in console only; owner-only, so never a console-control command)
node framework/cli/build-limit.mjs set maxBuilds=N (at a terminal)
read: Agent cap plugin API: GET hard-limit, GET status (cap, hard.live); plugin commands hard-limit / status (MCP, voice)

aliases.migration: migrateBuildsAtOnce() in framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs → a settings-migrated line in <agent-slots dir>/build-limit.log.jsonl

distinct.label: Steps in parallel
distinct.why: Steps of one build that run at once, under Builds at once. Nothing else does this job.

distinct.label: Sessions per build before it stops
distinct.why: Counts every session a build has had. The recovery watchdog's count restarts at each ticked step; Pipeline 2.0, the lander and the retry ladder count attempts of their own units.

distinct.label: Heavy steps at once
distinct.why: Vite builds, docker test runs and Playwright: a different resource from builds.

distinct.label: Emergency slots
distinct.why: A second pool, counted apart from Builds at once.

sameName.readme: A key name the audit finds in more than one store passes only when listed here: `oneStore` = the folders hold one store between them (an allow-list or default table of the same file in another language), `differentSettings` = the same name on settings that are not the same thing. Anything else fails CI until one becomes the source and the other its alias (sources above), or the reason is written down here.

oneStore.why: The plugin server's allow-list for the engine's one settings file (<agent-slots dir>/settings.json).
The lazy-loading defaults of one document, in Python for the server and TypeScript for the shell.
The recovery watchdog's settings file on top of build-watchdog@1's defaults: one file.

differentSettings.enabled: The on/off switch of separate features, each in its own file.
differentSettings.on: The on/off switch of separate features, each in its own file.
differentSettings.sound: The activity banner's done sound and the approvals alarm are separate sounds.
differentSettings.tools: The assistant's chat-mode tool policy and the headless launcher's tool list are separate lists.
differentSettings.intervalMin: How often two unrelated jobs run (the recovery watchdog, the chat viewer's sync).
differentSettings.project: The recorder's target project and hub sync's project are separate picks.
differentSettings.graceMin: Three watchdogs, each with its own grace period: the recovery watchdog (build-watchdog@1), watchdog 2 and the reaper.
differentSettings.maxAttempts: Attempts of different units: a Pipeline 2.0 step (watchdog 2), a landing run (lander, auto-lander policy), a retry ladder rung.
